description: Show the most-liked public feedback across the community, optionally scoped to an entity, topic, or section. Each item has an optional replyAction for that thread. Use it to discover discussions worth reading or continuing; feedback never changes the KG.

limit.description: Maximum popular feedback items to return.

offset.description: Offset for reading the next page; check hasMore/nextOffset.

targetId.description: Optional entity id, topic slug, or section id. If provided, targetType is required.

name: get_popular_feedback
title: Show popular feedback
